messages:
maria zhao: Heads-up — seeing a sustained p50/p95 latency regression from the inference pool in us-west-2. Started ~01:23 UTC, affects nodes rack21-node03..node06. p50 went 120ms -> ~420ms. :frowning:

infra-bot: :rotating_light: alert: latency_spike detected for /dedicated/infer-usw2 (policy=throughput). Candidates: rack21-node03,rack21-node04. CPU normal, IO spike on kernel AER retries.

ajay singh: quick glance on node03: ECC counters jumping on GPU 2 and 3. Also seeing a stream of AER entries in dmesg. Pasting relevant tail:
```
[ 1423.123456] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received: id=00e0
[ 1423.123460] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:81:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1423.123465] nvlink: link 1->2 down, retrying
[ 1423.125000] pcieport 0000:01:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: id=00a0
```

leo nguyen: That pattern (AER + nvlink link flaps + Xid 79) matches what we saw on rack11 last month — causes transient stalls and a burst of retries that backpressure the scheduler. Soft-drain the affected GPUs, not full node, to limit impact.

maria zhao: Can we soft-drain GPUs 2/3 on node03 first? command I'm thinking: `node-drain --node rack21-node03 --gpus 2,3 --reason "pcie-aer/xid"` — will runtime reallocate queued batches to other nodes?

ajay singh: Yes, runtime will requeue active batches subject to backoff. After drain, run `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC` and `dmesg -T | tail -n 100` to confirm counters stop increasing. If nvlink still flapping, we'll need to swap the card or bridge. I'll open a spare allocation on rack22.

oncall-rotation: tagging @leo for after-hours follow-up and RMA timeline. Also uploading logs to s3://redwood-infra-logs/1769998888/rack21-node03.tar.gz (will be available in ~5m).

leo nguyen: Ack. Plan: 1) soft-drain GPUs 2&3 node03 now, 2) run memtest/nightly stress overnight, 3) if flaps persist replace GPU+NVLink bridge in the morning and RMA card. If we end up replacing, expect ~3-5% throughput hit across pool until spare warms up.

maria zhao: thanks. noted expected perf/cost hit. I'll post an update after the drain. :thumbsup:
